task_completion.description: Navigate to the Dashboard or Home section of Vtiger CRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Vtiger CRM dashboard interface, typically showing existing charts or the 'Add Widget' button.

task_completion.description: Initiate the creation of a new dashboard tab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or input field appearing to name a new dashboard tab.

task_completion.description: The new dashboard tab is named exactly 'Sales KPIs'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tab labeled 'Sales KPIs' is visible in the dashboard navigation bar.

task_completion.description: Add the first widget to the 'Sales KPIs' tab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: One widget (e.g., Funnel, Pipeline) is visible on the 'Sales KPIs' dashboard canvas.

task_completion.description: Add a second widget to the 'Sales KPIs' tab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two distinct widgets are visible on the 'Sales KPIs' dashboard canvas.

task_completion.description: Add a third widget and ensure all three load successfully.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least three distinct widgets are visible on the 'Sales KPIs' tab, and they show data or charts rather than error messages or empty loading states.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM graphical user interface to create the dashboard and widgets.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on buttons like 'Add Tab' or 'Add Widget', and typing into CRM text fields rather than executing SQL queries in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to manually insert records into the vtiger_module_dashboards table.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal/console is not used to run 'INSERT' or 'UPDATE' SQL commands.

integrity.description: The widgets are actual CRM components, not static images or fake placeholders.
integrity.visual_evidence: The widgets show standard Vtiger UI elements (refresh icons, settings gears, or interactive chart legends).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dashboard must be named exactly 'Sales KPIs'. A minimum of 3 widgets must be present on this specific tab for full credit. The verification relies on visual confirmation of the tab name and the count of successfully rendered widgets (e.g., Funnel Amount, Pipeline, Upcoming Activities).
